fusions.name: Flywheel Released
fusions.desc: Sends a heavy rim rolling at a target up to 7 tiles away. It deals 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Rim-Shod Shove
fusions.desc: A shoulder-first shove that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flywheel Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 12% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Unstoppable Rolling
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
